note: 24ª vaga (2026-08-28, Fase 24, continuação do R1). Tema: Viagens e Turismo (nível intermédio-avançado). 12 headwords inicialmente escritos foram removidos por já existirem noutros bancos (connecting flight/off the beaten track/backpacking/landmark/one-way ticket/authentic/homesick/itinerary/layover/jet lag/currency exchange/visa) — verificado por comparação automática de todos os headwords do currículo antes do commit final.

words.definition_en: a document allowing a passenger to board a plane
example_sentences: Please have your boarding pass ready.

words.definition_en: phrasal verb: to hand over luggage before a flight
example_sentences: We checked in our suitcases at the counter.

words.definition_en: hand luggage taken onto a plane
example_sentences: I only travel with carry-on luggage.

words.definition_en: the storage space above passenger seats on a plane
example_sentences: Put your bag in the overhead bin.

words.definition_en: the area in an airport where passengers collect their luggage
example_sentences: Meet us at baggage claim.

words.definition_en: the place at a border where goods are checked
example_sentences: We had nothing to declare at customs.

words.definition_en: later than scheduled
example_sentences: Our flight was delayed by two hours.

words.definition_en: no longer going to happen
example_sentences: The train was cancelled due to a strike.

words.definition_en: (of a flight) having more bookings than available seats
example_sentences: The flight was overbooked, so they asked for volunteers.

words.definition_en: money paid to make up for a loss or inconvenience
example_sentences: We received compensation for the delay.

words.definition_en: money given back to a customer
example_sentences: We asked for a full refund.

words.definition_en: a place to stay, such as a hotel or rental
example_sentences: The price includes accommodation and breakfast.

words.definition_en: collocation: to arrange something before it is needed
example_sentences: It's cheaper if you book in advance.

words.definition_en: with no more availability
example_sentences: The hotel was fully booked for the weekend.

words.definition_en: useful or desirable features of a place, such as a pool or gym
example_sentences: The hotel offers a range of amenities.

words.definition_en: the time by which guests must leave a hotel room
example_sentences: Check-out time is midday.

words.definition_en: to charge someone more than the correct amount
example_sentences: The taxi driver tried to overcharge us.

words.definition_en: to negotiate the price of something, especially at a market
example_sentences: You can haggle over prices at the local market.

words.definition_en: idiom: a place that overcharges tourists and lacks authenticity
example_sentences: That restaurant near the monument is a total tourist trap.

words.definition_en: disorientation experienced when encountering a very different culture
example_sentences: She experienced culture shock during her first week abroad.

words.definition_en: to become fully involved in an activity or culture
example_sentences: She immersed herself in the local culture.

words.definition_en: a person living outside their native country
example_sentences: There's a large expatriate community in the city.

words.definition_en: visiting places of interest as a tourist
example_sentences: We spent the day sightseeing in the old town.

words.definition_en: having beautiful natural scenery
example_sentences: We took the scenic route along the coast.

words.definition_en: extremely impressive or beautiful
example_sentences: The view from the top was breathtaking.

words.definition_en: quiet and private, away from crowds
example_sentences: We found a secluded beach nearby.

words.definition_en: full of activity and people
example_sentences: The bustling market sells everything from spices to fabric.

words.definition_en: attractively old-fashioned or unusual
example_sentences: We stayed in a quaint little village.

words.definition_en: a short stay at a place during a longer journey
example_sentences: We had a two-day stopover in Dubai.

words.definition_en: a journey to a place and back again
example_sentences: A round trip ticket was cheaper than one-way.

words.definition_en: insurance covering risks during travel, such as illness or cancellation
example_sentences: Always buy travel insurance before a long trip.

words.definition_en: the traditional food of a particular region
example_sentences: Trying the local cuisine was the highlight of the trip.
